narratives.narrative: The quarter included related-party revenue, receivables, contract assets, and contract liabilities. It also included conditional acquisition consideration and an extraction flag concerning alternative revenue readings.

The quarter included related-party revenue and contract assets, as well as a conditional acquisition agreement. The period also included financing proceeds from the Ampere interest and settlement of a convertible loan.

The quarter included substantial non-cancelable purchase obligations and lease commitments. Related-party revenue and contract assets were also reported, together with a flag identifying off-balance-sheet obligations.

The quarter included conditional Arm China contract liabilities and a conditional related-party contract asset. The filings also reported related-party revenue and financing relationships, changing ACV definitions, and subsequent transactions that recontextualize commitments.

prose.overview: Revenue reached $4.5 billion over the trailing year, while expenses were $4.0 billion. Revenue grew 24% per year, faster than expense growth of 18%, and the backlog was 0.5x one year of revenue.
prose.debt: All $464 million of total committed money is tied to leases. That makes committed obligations equal to reported lease commitments, with no separate purchase obligations shown.
prose.wall: The next five years bring $1.0 billion of obligations due against $96.7 billion of future revenue promised to the company. Another $286 million of lease obligations comes due after year five.
